name: Exterior Fiber Cement Siding Prime Coat
intent: Single prime coat. Acrylic primer for factory-primed. Bonding primer for ColorPlus factory-finished. Spray-only or brush/roll.
doctrine: NC prime for fiber cement. Spray 350 SF/hr. Brush/roll 100 as fallback. Primer product driven by substrate state: acrylic for factory-primed, bonding for ColorPlus factory-finished. Profile and texture modifiers apply.
